recommendation: Conduct home-based food needs assessment and education
implementation_steps: Conduct home-based assessments of food needs and kitchen resources
Provide culturally appropriate education on nutrition resources
Facilitate community connections to food support systems
Assist with transportation to food resources when needed
Follow up to ensure ongoing access to adequate nutrition
evidence_summary: CHW-led home-based assessment and education interventions have demonstrated improvements in food security status and nutritional outcomes, particularly in underserved communities with limited access to traditional healthcare services.
